mapper.select:
SELECT FROM task_dependency d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task t WHERE t.id = d.from_task_id AND t.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task t WHERE t.id = d.to_task_id AND t.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL)
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM task t JOIN project_member pm ON pm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = t.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} WHERE t.id = d.from_task_id AND t.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND pm.access = 'none') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM task t JOIN project_member pm ON pm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = t.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} WHERE t.id = d.to_task_id AND t.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND pm.access = 'none')
ORDER BY d.created_at, d.id

SELECT FROM task_dependency d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (d.from_task_id = #{taskId} OR d.to_task_id = #{taskId}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task t WHERE t.id = d.from_task_id AND t.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task t WHERE t.id = d.to_task_id AND t.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL)
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM task t JOIN project_member pm ON pm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = t.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} WHERE t.id = d.from_task_id AND t.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND pm.access = 'none') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM task t JOIN project_member pm ON pm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = t.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} WHERE t.id = d.to_task_id AND t.workspace_id = d.workspace_id AND pm.access = 'none')
ORDER BY d.created_at, d.id
